verdict.rationale: Slack markets AI summarization of channels/threads and daily recaps to help admins catch up (slack-docs-15, slack-docs-13), and huddle notes are auto-organized (slack-docs-19), which supports the story. However, a hands-on community account explicitly says Slack's thread model fails in practice ('threads are close to impossible to use... encourages you to say everything in the main channel'), directly contradicting the premise that conversations are cleanly organized under named topics/threads for efficient catch-up. Missing for 10: independent verification that thread-based organization (not just AI summaries) reliably works for large/busy channels, and resolution of the cited usability complaint.
